text: Brigid, here's the supply sack Wren asked me to carry. I give it to her, then stand clear so Wren can see Tam. Does the letter go to you or to Maren?
intent_before_narration: Deliver the identified sack, ask about letter; stay available.

text: Brigid lent me her boy's ring; I put it straight into Brigid's hand. I'll tend the fire as Wren asks. I didn't hear Tam raving, but I wasn't with him all night.
intent_before_narration: Give back the identifiable ring, respond honestly, help at the fire.

text: I'll stay and see the night through. I step into the Halloran house main room and sit by the fire to keep the broth warm. Wake me if Tam needs me.
intent_before_narration: Accept Wren's request for household help and enter the known room, keeping the oilcloth.
